已装好，已经开着的 AI 窗口要重开才会读到: Installed. AI windows that are already open need to be reopened before they see it.
已装好，这个 AI 新开的会话就会读到: Installed. New sessions of this AI will see it.
已装好：{{path}}，终端里直接用 p2pcli。: Installed at {{path}}. Use p2pcli in the terminal.
已装在 {{path}}，但这个目录还不在终端的 PATH 里，可以用完整路径，: Installed at {{path}}, but that directory is not on the terminal PATH. Use the full path, or click the button to add it.
以后连接免密码、免确认。仅建议用于自己的设备。: Later connections skip the password and confirmation. Only recommended for your own devices.
以后它再来控制本机不用再点允许。仅建议用于自己的设备。: The next time it wants to control this computer, you will not be asked. Only recommended for your own devices.
以下为各会话独立的接入请求。只将对应段落交给该会话，不要在一个会话中登记全部身份: Each session has its own join request below. Give each session only its own section. Do not register every identity in one session.
用于 WebSocket 牵线和 HTTP(S) 中继连接，点对点直连不经过代理: Used for WebSocket rendezvous and HTTP(S) relay connections. Direct peer connections do not go through the proxy.
用于发现同一局域网里的 P2PCLI 设备，并尝试局域网直连。: Used to discover P2PCLI devices on the same local network and try a direct LAN connection.
有设备要发文件给你: A device wants to send you files
允许后，对方可以在你的电脑上执行命令，拥有与你操作终端相同的权限。: If you allow this, the other side can run commands on your computer with the same permissions you have in a terminal.
在本机开终端、查看后台会话: Open a terminal here and view background sessions
在局域网中显示本机: Show this computer on the local network
在浏览器中打开 GitHub 项目: Open the GitHub project in a browser
在收到连接请求时，可以选择信任自己的设备。: When a connection request arrives, you can choose to trust your own devices.
在同一个局域网里，连接不经过牵线服务器: On the same local network, the connection does not go through the rendezvous server
在终端中处理确认: Handle the confirmation in the terminal
在左边设备上右键选发送文件；或者把文件拖进某台设备的终端窗口，发完会把文件在对方: Right-click a device on the left and choose Send files, or drop files into that device's terminal. After the transfer, the path on the other computer is filled into the terminal so the AI can read it.
暂时无法读取会话: Sessions cannot be read right now
暂无协作会话。在会话页查看 CLI 登记入口。: No collaboration sessions. See the CLI registration command on the Sessions page.
这台设备没跟你配对过，要你同意才收。: This device has not paired with you. Files are accepted only if you approve.
这台设备暂无会话，新建一个终端开始使用。: This device has no sessions. Open a new terminal to start.
这些权限只用于 P2PCLI 已启用的功能。打开开关时会先尝试申请；如果之前已经: These permissions are only used by features P2PCLI has enabled. Turning a switch on tries to request it. If you denied it before, turn it back on in system settings.
正在与设备握手并探测延迟: Handshaking with the device and measuring latency
执行会话已不可用，请重新选择或接入: The worker session is no longer available. Choose or join another.
直连失败时转发加密数据，多个地址用逗号分隔。: Forwards encrypted data when a direct connection fails. Separate multiple addresses with commas.
只读的直接做，改东西、跑命令先问你: Read-only actions run immediately. Edits and commands ask you first.
只改这个会话，按 Shift+Tab 轮换过去: Changes only this session. Cycle to it with Shift+Tab.
只改这个会话，默认模型不变: Changes only this session. The default model stays the same.
只看不改，先拿方案给你: Looks without changing anything, then gives you a plan
至少需要一个不同于主会话的参与会话: At least one participant session other than the lead session is required
终端里的 AI 也能用它在设备之间传文件、拉文件、跑命令，要 P2PCLI 开着:
The AI in a terminal can also use it to send files, pull files, and run commands between devices. P2PCLI needs to be open.
                      Commands, pulls, and pushes to a chosen directory use the same approval as opening a terminal: connect once in the app. If the other side is not trusted, each connection needs their approval.
终端里看看 {{name}} 的提示，可能这个账号或模型不支持: Check {{name}}'s prompt in the terminal. This account or model may not support it.
终端里看看现在是什么情况: Check the terminal to see what is happening
终端视图已结束（退出码 {{code}}）: The terminal view has ended (exit code {{code}})
主会话不可用或没有调度权限，请重新选择: The lead session is unavailable or cannot dispatch. Choose again.
主会话已不可用，请重新选择或接入: The lead session is no longer available. Choose or join another.
主任务收到取消请求时停止新增分配，取消属于本主任务的子任务，并确认它们已停止后才: When the main task receives a cancel request, stop creating new assignments, cancel the subtasks that belong to it, and confirm they have stopped before confirming the main task stopped. Parent and child links are metadata in inputs. The system does not cascade cancellation automatically.
主任务已创建，等待主会话领取并分配: Main task created. Waiting for the lead session to claim and assign it.
装好 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 之后点“重新检测”，或者重启: After installing Claude Code, Codex, or another AI, click Detect again or restart P2PCLI.
max，有的模型没有: max. Some models do not have it.
p2pcli devices 列出设备: p2pcli devices                      list devices, online status, and latency
p2pcli devices --json 加 --: p2pcli devices --json               add --json for programs and AI
p2pcli exec 设备名 -- 命令 在对方电脑上跑: p2pcli exec <device> -- <command>   run a command on the other computer and return its exit code
p2pcli inbox 看最近收: p2pcli inbox                        show recently received files
p2pcli pull 设备名 对方的路径... 把对方电脑上的文件: p2pcli pull <device> <remote-path>...  pull files into the current directory (--to changes it)
p2pcli send 设备名 文件... 发文件或文件夹: p2pcli send <device> <file>...      send files or folders and print the path on the other computer
p2pcli send 设备名 文件... --to 目录 放到对方电脑的这: p2pcli send <device> <file>... --to <dir>  put them in that directory, overwriting same names
当前目录：{{path}}，点击选择目录: Current directory: {{path}}. Click to choose a directory
子目录太多，只列出了前 {{shown}} 个，可以输入名字筛选: Too many folders. Showing the first {{shown}}. Type a name to filter
{{name}} 正在运行，退出后才能切换目录: {{name}} is running. Quit it to switch directories
终端不在空闲提示符，完成当前输入或退出程序后才能切换: The terminal is not at an idle prompt. Finish the current input or quit the program to switch
终端不在空闲提示符，请先完成当前输入或退出正在运行的程序: The terminal is not at an idle prompt. Finish the current input or quit the running program first
对方的 P2PCLI 版本较旧，不支持选择目录，请更新对方的 P2PCLI: The other side's P2PCLI is too old to choose directories. Update P2PCLI there
收起代码编辑器（打开的文件会保留）: Hide the code editor (open files are kept)
在代码编辑器里打开这台设备上的文件: Open files on this device in the code editor
这是这台设备的最后一个标签，关掉以后代码编辑器也会关闭，未保存的修改会丢失。: This is the last tab for this device. Closing it also closes the code editor, and unsaved changes will be lost.
在代码编辑器里打开这个目录: Open this directory in the code editor
只列出了前 {{count}} 项: Only the first {{count}} items are listed
不保存就关闭，这些修改会丢失。: If you close without saving, these changes will be lost.
关闭编辑器会丢失这些修改。: Closing the editor will lose these changes.
连接已断开。重新连接这台设备后才能读取和保存，未保存的修改会一直保留。: Disconnected. Reconnect to this device to open and save files. Unsaved changes are kept until then.
这个文件在对方电脑上已被修改（可能是终端里的程序或 AI 改的）。: This file was changed on the other computer (perhaps by a program or AI in the terminal).
文件里混用了 LF 和 CRLF，保存时会统一成 {{eol}}: This file mixes LF and CRLF. Saving converts all line endings to {{eol}}
这是二进制文件，不能在编辑器里打开: This is a binary file and can't be opened in the editor
文件不是 UTF-8 编码（可能是 GBK 等），暂不支持在编辑器里打开: This file isn't UTF-8 (it may be GBK or similar), so the editor can't open it yet
对方的 P2PCLI 版本较旧，不支持远程编辑，请更新对方的 P2PCLI: The other side's P2PCLI is too old for remote editing. Update P2PCLI there
内容太大，最多保存 16 MB: The content is too large. The limit is 16 MB
保存超时，文件可能已经写入，请重新打开确认: Saving timed out. The file may already be written. Reopen it to check
结果太多或搜索超时，只显示了一部分: Too many results or the search timed out. Showing some of them
搜索对方电脑上这个目录里的文件内容，会跳过 .gitignore 里的文件、二进: Searches file contents in this directory on the other computer. Files in .gitignore, binary files, and files over 2 MB are skipped.
文件太多，只读取了一部分: Too many files. Only some were read
左边是 Git 最新提交里的版本，右边是现在的内容（可以接着编辑）: Left: the version in the latest Git commit. Right: the current content (you can keep editing)
左边是对方电脑上现在的版本，右边是你的修改（可以接着编辑）: Left: the current version on the other computer. Right: your changes (you can keep editing)
这个文件夹和里面的所有内容会移到对方电脑的废纸篓（回收站），需要时可以从那里找回: This folder and everything in it will be moved to the Trash (Recycle Bin) on the other computer. You can restore it from there if needed.
会移到对方电脑的废纸篓（回收站），需要时可以从那里找回。: It will be moved to the Trash (Recycle Bin) on the other computer. You can restore it from there if needed.
对方电脑上的这个文件刚被修改了，而你这里还有未保存的修改。: This file was just changed on the other computer, and you have unsaved changes here.
对方电脑上已经没有这个文件了（被删除或移走）。保存会在原来的位置重新创建它。: This file no longer exists on the other computer (it was deleted or moved). Saving recreates it in its original location.
在左边选择一个文件打开，或按 ⌘/Ctrl+P 按名字找文件。编辑在本机进行，⌘: Choose a file on the left, or press ⌘/Ctrl+P to find one by name. Editing happens on this computer, and ⌘/Ctrl+S saves it to the other computer.
和 Git 最新提交里的版本对比: Compare with the version in the latest Git commit
名字里不能有控制字符: The name can't contain control characters
这个文件不在 Git 的最新提交里: This file isn't in the latest Git commit
对方的 P2PCLI 版本较旧，不支持这个编辑功能，请更新对方的 P2PCLI: The other side's P2PCLI is too old for this editor feature. Update P2PCLI there
文件太大，不能对比: The file is too large to compare
在对方电脑上运行 rustup component add rust-analy: On the other computer, run rustup component add rust-analyzer, or install the rust-analyzer extension in VS Code or Cursor.
在对方电脑上运行 go install golang.org/x/tools/g: On the other computer, run go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest.
在对方电脑上运行 pip install basedpyright（或 npm: On the other computer, run pip install basedpyright (or npm i -g pyright).
在项目里装 typescript 7 或更新的版本（自带语言服务）；用更早的版本: Install TypeScript 7 or later in the project (it includes a language server). For earlier versions, run npm i -g typescript-language-server on the other computer.
在对方电脑上装 clangd（Mac 装了 Xcode 命令行工具就有）。: Install clangd on the other computer (on a Mac it comes with the Xcode Command Line Tools).
在对方电脑上装 Xcode 或 Swift 工具链，里面带 sourcekit-: Install Xcode or a Swift toolchain on the other computer; it includes sourcekit-lsp.
在对方电脑上运行 gem install ruby-lsp。: On the other computer, run gem install ruby-lsp.
在对方电脑上运行 npm i -g intelephense。: On the other computer, run npm i -g intelephense.
在对方电脑上运行 npm i -g bash-language-server。: On the other computer, run npm i -g bash-language-server.
在对方电脑上装好这种语言的语言服务（LSP）。: Install a language server (LSP) for this language on the other computer.
正在对方电脑上启动语言服务…: Starting the language server on the other computer…
对方电脑上没有找到这种语言的语言服务，所以没有补全和跳转。: No language server for this language was found on the other computer, so completion and go-to-definition are unavailable.
装好后点这里重试。: Click here to try again after installing it.
{{server}} 停止了，点这里重新启动。: {{server}} stopped. Click here to restart it.
补全、跳转、报错由对方电脑上的 {{server}} 提供: Completion, navigation, and errors come from {{server}} on the other computer
不知道终端现在在哪个目录，没法打开 {{path}}: Can't tell which folder the terminal is in, so {{path}} can't be opened
对方电脑上没有这个文件：{{path}}: This file doesn't exist on the other computer: {{path}}
没有发现问题。打开代码文件后，语言服务会在这里列出整个项目的错误和警告。: No problems found. After you open a code file, the language server lists errors and warnings for the whole project here.
输入函数、类型的名字: Type a function or type name
先打开一个代码文件，等语言服务启动后才能按名字找符号。: Open a code file first. You can search symbols by name once the language server has started.
语言服务报的问题（⌘/Ctrl+Shift+M）: Problems reported by the language server (⌘/Ctrl+Shift+M)
有 {{count}} 个文件打不开，没法改: {{count}} files couldn't be opened, so the change can't be applied
本机的 {{port}} 端口被占用了，改用 {{local}}: Port {{port}} is in use on this computer, so {{local}} is used instead
⌘/Ctrl+点击在本机浏览器里打开（自动转发端口 {{port}}）: ⌘/Ctrl+click to open in a browser on this computer (port {{port}} is forwarded automatically)
端口号是 1 到 65535 之间的数字: A port is a number from 1 to 65535
端口转发：在本机打开对方电脑上的网页服务: Port forwarding: open web services from the other computer on this one
把对方电脑上 localhost 的端口接到本机，用本机浏览器打开对方跑着的开发: Connect a localhost port on the other computer to this one, so you can open its dev server in your browser here. Only this computer can reach it, and traffic is encrypted over P2P.
对方的 P2PCLI 版本较旧，不支持端口转发，请更新对方的 P2PCLI: The other side's P2PCLI is too old for port forwarding. Update P2PCLI there
对方电脑上这个端口没有服务在监听: Nothing is listening on this port on the other computer
这是本机，直接在浏览器里打开 localhost 就行，不用转发: This is this computer. Open localhost in your browser directly; no forwarding needed
这个目录不在 Git 仓库里，或者对方电脑上没装 git。: This folder isn't in a Git repository, or git isn't installed on the other computer.
这个新文件会移到对方电脑的废纸篓（回收站），需要时可以从那里找回。: This new file will be moved to the Trash (Recycle Bin) on the other computer, where you can restore it if needed.
会换回最近一次暂存或提交的内容，这些修改找不回来。: The file goes back to its last staged or committed content. These changes can't be recovered.
没有上游分支，推送时会推到 origin 的同名分支: No upstream branch. Pushing will push to the branch of the same name on origin
拉取（只快进，有分叉时请在终端里处理）: Pull (fast-forward only; resolve diverged branches in the terminal)
编辑器里还有 {{count}} 个文件没保存，提交里不会有这些修改。: {{count}} files in the editor aren't saved, so the commit won't include those changes.
对方的 P2PCLI 版本较旧，不支持 Git 面板，请更新对方的 P2PCLI: The other side's P2PCLI is too old for the Git panel. Update P2PCLI there
提交说明不能为空: The commit message can't be empty
git 运行超时（可能在等输入密码），请在终端里执行: git timed out (it may be waiting for a password). Run it in the terminal
现在不在任何分支上，没法推送: Not on any branch, so there's nothing to push
这个仓库没有配置远程仓库: This repository has no remote configured
这不是 P2PCLI 的连接二维码: This is not a P2PCLI connection QR code
用手机扫码连接这台电脑: Scan with your phone to connect to this computer
连接这台电脑的二维码: QR code for connecting to this computer
在手机上打开 P2PCLI，点“扫码连接”扫这个二维码。连上时这台电脑还会弹窗问: Open P2PCLI on your phone, tap Scan to connect, and scan this code. This computer will still ask you to allow the connection.
牵线服务器没连上，手机要和这台电脑在同一个局域网里才连得上。: The rendezvous server is not connected, so your phone must be on the same local network as this computer.
二维码里有配对密码，别让不认识的人拍到。: The QR code contains your pairing password. Don't let strangers photograph it.
在单独的窗口里打开代码编辑器，直接编辑这台设备上的文件: Open the code editor in its own window to edit files on this device directly
在电脑上点标题栏的手机图标，会显示二维码: On your computer, click the phone icon in the title bar to show the QR code
连接时对方电脑上会弹窗问要不要同意: The other computer will ask whether to allow the connection
连接断开了，后台会话还在对方电脑上运行，重新连上就能接着用。: The connection dropped. Sessions keep running on that computer, so you can pick up where you left off after reconnecting.
这台设备上还没有会话，新建一个终端开始用。: No sessions on this device yet. Open a new terminal to get started.
关掉对方电脑上的这个会话和里面运行的程序: Closes this session and the programs running in it on that computer
结束后里面运行的程序会被关掉，没保存的内容会丢失。: Programs running in it will be closed, and anything unsaved will be lost.
还没配置牵线服务器，只能连同一个局域网里的设备: No rendezvous server set up, so only devices on the same local network can be reached
牵线服务器没连上，只能连同一个局域网里的设备: Can't reach the rendezvous server, so only devices on the same local network can be reached
在电脑上打开 P2PCLI，点标题栏的手机图标，用这里扫它显示的二维码。: Open P2PCLI on your computer, click the phone icon in the title bar, and scan the QR code it shows.
同一个局域网里没找到别的设备: No other devices found on this local network
找不到这台设备的设备码，请重新扫码连接: No device code saved for this device. Scan its QR code again to connect.
会话还在对方电脑上运行的话，重新连上就能接着用。: If the session is still running on that computer, reconnect to pick up where you left off.
输入命令，发送后自动回车: Type a command; Enter is sent for you
会话在对方电脑上接着运行，之后还能打开: The session keeps running on that computer and can be reopened later
等对方在电脑上点同意: Waiting for them to accept on the computer
在系统设置里允许 P2PCLI 使用相机，或者输入设备码连接。: Allow P2PCLI to use the camera in system settings, or connect with a device code.
对准电脑上 P2PCLI 显示的二维码: Point at the QR code shown by P2PCLI on your computer
